packages.name: figcraft-collab
packages.description: FigCraft real-time collaboration core: the synced object/property model, change sets, fractional positions, server ordering and validation, client reconciliation, per-user undo, offline queueing and reconnect, and the wire messages (no networking)

packages.name: figcraft-doc
packages.description: FigCraft document model: pages, the node tree, properties, components, styles, variables, prototype data

packages.name: figcraft-color
packages.description: FigCraft colour and paint: RGBA colours, HSB/HSL/LCH/OKLCH, hex/CSS parsing, solid/gradient/image paints, blend modes

packages.name: figcraft-geom
packages.description: FigCraft geometry: affine transforms, shape path builders (rounded/smoothed corners, polygons, stars, arcs)

packages.name: figcraft-collab-net
packages.description: FigCraft live sessions over the network: the WebSocket transport, the session host the app embeds, invite links and presence relay (carries figcraft-collab's messages)

packages.name: figcraft-engine
packages.description: FigCraft engine: sessions, undo history, the command registry every surface (UI, CLI, control channel, MCP) dispatches through, pointer tools, components and the Figma menu catalog

packages.name: figcraft-format
packages.description: FigCraft native file format (.figcraft: zip of document.json + images), image import helpers, REST API file JSON import and .fig import

packages.name: figcraft-layout
packages.description: FigCraft layout: auto layout (horizontal, vertical, wrap, grid; hug/fill/fixed), constraints, layout grid geometry

packages.name: figcraft-pathops
packages.description: FigCraft path operations: booleans (union, subtract, intersect, exclude), outline stroke with inside/center/outside alignment, arrowheads

packages.name: figcraft-pdf
packages.description: FigCraft PDF export (krilla): vector shapes, gradients, embedded images, aligned strokes as outlines, clips, masks, blend modes, real selectable text, effects as rasters, print options (bleed, marks, page boxes, CMYK)

packages.name: figcraft-render
packages.description: FigCraft renderer: the scene graph to pixels on tiny-skia (fills, gradients, images, aligned strokes, shadows, blurs, masks, blend modes, text)

packages.name: figcraft-text
packages.description: FigCraft text: font database (embedded craft-fonts + system fonts), shaping, line layout, glyph outlines

packages.name: figcraft-plugin
packages.description: FigCraft plugins: the plugin manifest and the WebAssembly sandbox plugins run in (a metered interpreter with no file system, network or clock)

packages.name: figcraft-svg
packages.description: FigCraft SVG export (shapes, gradients, images, strokes, effects as filters, text as outlines) and import (via usvg)

packages.name: figcraft-vectordrawable
packages.description: FigCraft Android Vector Drawable export (shapes, strokes, gradients, clips and vector masks as a <vector> XML drawable)

packages.name: figcraft-mcp
packages.description: FigCraft MCP server: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio, driving a headless engine session or a running FigCraft app

packages.name: figcraft-ui-egui
packages.description: FigCraft egui frontend (the Figma-style UI: canvas, toolbar, layers, design and prototype panels, menus); swappable: nothing below depends on it

packages.name: figcraft
packages.description: FigCraft desktop app

packages.name: figcraft-cli
packages.description: FigCraft command line: info, export, convert, render, scripted commands, MCP server, perf

packages.name: figcraft-server
packages.description: FigCraft's standalone collaboration server: keeps many files with share links (edit or view), persists them as snapshots plus a log, and serves live sessions (headless, native only)

packages.name: figcraft-web
packages.description: FigCraft in the browser (eframe web runner, WebGPU with WebGL2 fallback)
